aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, Śiva, abode of the world, giver of happiness.
aarti.pad1: You are ageless, deathless, unborn, formless, being, consciousness and bliss in form; all-pervading, Brahman itself. Śiva, you take away the fear of worldly existence. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: The young moon shines on your forehead, your mass of matted locks is filled with the Gaṅgā; your three eyes are very large, and you are the burner of Madana, the god of love. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: For your devotees' sake you bear the trident, and turn their harsh pains into flowers; you take away every ache of the heart and give unshakable peace. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Your spotless, rosy lotus feet fulfil every wish; they give pure devotion and liberation and dispel the delusion of māyā. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: With Kārttikeya and Gaṇeśa, and with Pārvatī, daughter of Himālaya, Maheśa reigns in the land of Kailāsa, without parts yet bearer of every kalā. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Ashes and serpents are the ornaments of your body; a garland of skulls, and a skull in your hand; a lion's skin and an elephant's hide, and the ḍamaru held in your hand. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: You are ever the refuge of those who have none, Āśutoṣa, quickly pleased, remover of distress, bringer of good in every way. Victory, victory to you, foe of Tripura. ॥7॥
